_meta.purpose: Golden corpus for the road-to-provenance-and-license-governance Phase 0 baseline (S0.1). Measures the deterministic provenance detector's sensitivity to transformation depth (seeded samples) and its false-positive behaviour on independently-authored code solving the same well-known task (independent samples). See README.md for the full sourcing decision and the honest Phase-0 limitation this implies for the G0 verdict.
_meta.sourcing: synthetic-canonical — every sample is an independently authored implementation of a well-known algorithm shape; none is fetched or pasted from a real upstream repository. See README.md.
